question: Can a portal-only reference credential from one Panoramax sequence be geometrically transported onto the exact same entrance portal in another sequence, while portal credentials from every wrong entrance fail?

cohort.selection_provenance: All three remaining metadata-admitted cross-collection candidates after excluding every prior active-recovery, node-text, and whole-viewport-reference way. No selected pixels or model outcomes were observed before freeze.
cohort.view_pair_rule: Within every eligible collection choose the strict DIRECT item nearest 40 metres to the entrance, tie by item id. Choose the cross-collection pair with the smallest absolute distance difference, then lexicographic collection and item ids. The lexicographically first collection is reference and the other is query.

annotation_contract.reference: A reference-only annotator sees no query pixels and marks exactly one portal box containing the projected entrance x coordinate, or marks AMBIGUOUS/NOT_VISIBLE. The box is runtime input authority.
annotation_contract.query: A disjoint query-only annotator sees no reference pixels and first emits a source-admission audit. Evaluator-private portal boxes are created only if every query is ADMITTED, and are loaded only after every model prediction is complete.
annotation_contract.admission: All three episodes must have one visible, unambiguous reference portal and one visible, unambiguous query portal. Any missing admission closes this source without model rescue.

reference_crop.rule: Expand the frozen reference portal box by 1.25 about its centre, clamp to the viewport, and preserve the unexpanded portal corners for transport.

matcher.backend_rule: Profile the frozen pair once on CPU and CUDA with the project research backend, then keep the measured selection for all nine ordered reference-query pairs.

evaluation.prediction: Estimate one reference-crop to full-query homography from EfficientLoFTR correspondences and transport the frozen unexpanded portal quadrilateral. There is no learned portal detector, OCR, threshold sweep, or candidate reranking.

stop_condition: Run once after both disjoint annotation manifests and hashes freeze. On failure do not tune crop expansion, matcher threshold, homography, IoU, view pair, model, or cohort; acquire a different entrance credential source or close pixel transfer.
claim_boundary: A pass is a three-entrance Development result showing that a separately annotated exact portal patch can be transported across real Panoramax sequences and rejects all wrong entrance patches. It is agent-annotated Development evidence, not independent confirmation, public or legal access, traversability, collision-free motion, metric waypoint or arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
